phases.name: candidate
phases.action: Deploy the candidate a85bfb57: it is the tip of remake/v3, so next-preview.yml has deployed it (merge nothing else until the rehearsal is done).

phases.name: hold
phases.action: gh variable set DEPLOY_HOLD --body legacy-final --repo faridbnv/h2c-materials

phases.name: hold-test
phases.action: Open a pull request that adds one number to "pings" in remake/control/rehearsal-ping.json and merge it into remake/v3 (agents merge into remake/v3 once checks are green). next-main.yml must verify and build and must NOT deploy.

phases.name: restore
phases.action: Open a pull request that puts the restore request into remake/control/restore.json (the JSON save-legacy.sh printed; its digest is in remake/legacy/legacy-final.json) and merge it into remake/v3. The merge is the moment "restore requested".

phases.name: check
phases.action: The legacy smoke profile runs here against the preview with the saved manifest.

phases.name: candidate-again
phases.action: The owner clears the hold: gh variable delete DEPLOY_HOLD --repo faridbnv/h2c-materials. An agent merges a pull request that sets "request" back to null in remake/control/restore.json, which starts a dry run that deploys the candidate again.
